title: Battery Engineering Team Manager
description:
Eaton’s Corporate Sector division is currently seeking a Battery Engineering Team Manager.


The expected annual salary range for this role is $137000 \- $201000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.


Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.


**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

Eaton is seeking an experienced Battery Team Manager for its Power Electronics (PE) and Battery Centers of Excellence (CoE) team in Raleigh, NC. Position requires up to 15% domestic and international travel.

These platforms and blocks, along with standardized design methodologies, can be adopted by multiple business units, providing a foundation for rapidly developing innovative products.
  

  

The team manager will be responsible for leading and directing a team of engineers and internal projects, as well as designing and building innovative battery solutions for Eaton’s products. This position requires a technically strong engineer with leadership skills capable of managing a cross\-functional team and collaborating with global teams.

* Leads and directs a team of engineers and projects to achieve stated goals and objectives.
* Monitors and reports on overall performance of the team and projects. Establishes a performance\-based culture, motivating the team to set and achieve measurable goals and objectives that align with Battery CoE strategies.
* Performs design, modeling, simulation, and implementation of battery solutions such as battery modules, packs, and BMS
* Develops technical requirements and creates technical reports and presentations.

title: Hardware Engineering Manager
description:
Eaton’s Electrical Sector – Energy Solutions and Services (ESS) division is seeking a Hardware Engineering Manager to join our Distributed Information Technology (D\-IT) Business Unit. This is a vital role as our teams continue to develop new digital technologies in our products and services portfolios. The preferred location for this position is Woodridge, IL (Chicago area). Relocation assistance is available. Minimal travel is expected (\~10%).


The expected annual salary range for this role is $113000 \- $165000 a year.


Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.  



We at Eaton are innovating future products with a focus on global sustainability megatrends: Energy Transition, Electrification, and Digital Enablement.


**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Hardware Engineering, you will lead a technical team that focuses on Datacenter Power Supply, Single Phase UPS, PDU and Cloud Connectivity platforms. You will be responsible for product architecture, technology selections, and will have a global impact while working with teams in APAC and EMEA, as well as across different Eaton divisions. As a leader in the D\-IT Chicago engineering department, you will manage a team of engineering professionals that includes electrical engineers and PCB designers. You will work closely with D\-IT engineering leaders, staff and engineering leaders from other Eaton divisions. Coaching, hiring, and other leadership responsibilities will fall under your scope.  



In this role, you will:

title: Project Manager – Data Center & Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Job Summary**

Edge Node, Inc. is building out multi\-site data center and cloud infrastructure across the U.S., and we need a hands\-on Project Manager to keep equipment, vendors, and sites moving in sync. You'll confirm Bills of Materials (BoMs) and delivery dates with OEM vendors, coordinate the contractors and suppliers delivering power infrastructure (UPS, PDUs, generators, switchgear), and work with our tower partners to decide which sites get provisioned based on available power and space. This role reports directly to the Chief Operating Officer. Remote (U.S.), with strong preference for candidates in the Dallas–Fort Worth area.

**Duties**

* Review, validate, and confirm BoMs with OEM vendors for all project equipment; keep BoM documentation and change logs current
* Track ship dates and delivery windows with OEMs and distributors and flag schedule risks early
* Act as the primary coordination point across OEMs, electrical contractors, equipment suppliers, and logistics providers so equipment is procured, delivered, and installed on schedule
* Drive procurement and delivery of power infrastructure (PDUs, UPS systems, generators, switchgear, transformers, busway, batteries) to meet each site's power requirements
* Build and maintain project schedules across multiple concurrent site deployments, including milestones, dependencies, and critical\-path items
* Coordinate engineering, facilities, IT operations, and finance/procurement on scope, budget, and timeline
* Work with facilities and electrical teams to align each site's power capacity plan with equipment deliveries; track power, cooling, space, and connectivity requirements per site
* Partner with tower partners to evaluate candidate sites, coordinate site surveys and resource assessments, and prioritize which locations to provision
* Maintain a site\-selection tracker showing resource availability, provisioning status, and partner commitments

title: AWS Sr. Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure, US West
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services has an immediate opening for a Senior Technical Program Manager to support data center infrastructure expansion. The TPM will lead cross functional teams to drive regional data center build projects, from inception through design, implementation, testing, and deployment.  

  

The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, and possess experience in tactical project management of highly technical initiatives, as well as strategic program management. Experience in managing data center infrastructure deployments is a plus. Candidates possessing a background in architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering, data center infrastructure/operations, and/or construction, who have transitioned to a program management discipline will have a distinct advantage.  

  

Candidate must be comfortable managing remote project delivery teams, and possess the ability to facilitate technical whiteboard sessions to troubleshoot project implementation issues, and remove barriers to project success. Being able to stand up cross\-functional teams, establish trust with a variety of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non\-value\-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery is a must.
  

  

The TPM will be fully competent in a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated proficiency in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking. Other requirements include proficiency with MS Office, MS Project and MS SharePoint. Experience with Tableau, Smartsheets, SQL and systems integration a plus.

title: Vice President, Electric Cooperative Markets
description:
**About Sparkfund**
-------------------



Sparkfund is the utility services company unlocking capacity on the grid. Through its Distributed Capacity Procurement (DCP) model, Sparkfund enables utilities, energy majors, and large\-load customers to deploy front\-of\-the\-meter batteries and gensets as distribution infrastructure. By adding targeted capacity exactly where and when the grid needs it most, DCP helps meet demand, support reliability, and put downward pressure on rates. Sparkfund supports program design, grid value assessment, asset host engagement, and value chain management to ensure on\-time, on\-budget deployment with maximum system value and lowest cost.



With more than 3,200 projects deployed across 43 states and more than 300MW of energized assets constructed, Sparkfund is transforming customer\-sited assets into a valuable portfolio resource for the benefit of our society. To learn more about Sparkfund, visit sparkfund.com.

**Vice President, Electric Cooperative Markets**
================================================


**Location:** Remote, United States  

**Department:** Growth  

**Reports To:** VP, Growth

This is a strategic individual\-contributor role with significant autonomy and enterprise\-level influence. While the role does not have direct people\-management responsibility, it will represent Sparkfund externally at the executive level and materially influence how we prioritize opportunities, partnerships, and resources across the electric cooperative market.
